children: NEW YORK — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan met with Minister of Foreign Affairs of Paraguay Rubén Ramírez Lezcano. The meeting was held on the sidelines of the high-level week of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York on Wednesday.
During the meeting, they reviewed bilateral relations and discussed the latest regional and international developments of mutual interest.
Following the meeting, the ministers signed an agreement on the mutual exemption from short-stay visa requirements for holders of diplomatic and special passports.
The agreement aims to streamline procedures, strengthen coordination, and expand areas of cooperation between the two friendly countries.
Saudi Ambassador to the United States of America Princess Reema bint Bandar also attended the meeting.
